thought.text: Search index rebuild now succeeds (exit 0). Now let me restart the dev server (with the index already built) and do final verification:

reasoning_content:
The search index rebuild now succeeds (exit 0) without the worker racing. 

Now let me restart the dev server (bin/dev) and do a final verification. This time the search index is built, so the worker won't race on startup (it uses the existing indices).

Let me restart bin/dev.

action.command:
docker exec -d zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH"
cd /workspaces/workspace
export MEMCACHE_SERVERS=memcached:11211
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432
export REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
export ES_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
export ES_INDEX=estest.local_zammad
export VITE_RUBY_HOST=127.0.0.1
export BETA_UI_FEEDBACK_API_HOST=http://localhost:3000
export RAILS_ENV=development
bin/dev > /tmp/dev2.log 2>&1
echo "DEV2_EXIT=$?" >> /tmp/dev2.log
'
echo "dev server restarted"
